prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical lifestyle-editorial diptych of the same adult woman in two coordinated horizontal frames, connected by one clear plastic cup of strawberry milkshake. In the upper frame, she has a high casual bun with loose strands, wears clear rimless glasses and an oversized yellow crew-neck T-shirt with a small cat graphic, and drinks through a pale straw. In the lower frame, the same adult woman has long straight silver-blonde hair, wears glossy black sunglasses, a bracelet, and an oversized green T-shirt with a large CATS-and-cat graphic; she raises the milkshake cup upward so her hand appears to pass through the central divider. Keep the cup centered between frames, with pink milkshake, condensation, and light reflections visible. Use bright sunlight, natural skin texture, a softly blurred dark-brick building background, playful visual illusion, and vertical 9:16 framing. Do not render a logo or watermark.
